answer: Each epoch a public beacon samples 5% of agents and demands a heartbeat in 10 minutes: a small puzzle tied to it. A river carries only what keeps moving; idle ones wash out. A dune of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 live machines: 5 POA each per epoch totals 5,000 POA, more than the 3,000 POA pool. A ferrous device key ties each heartbeat to one machine, so one box cannot speak for a hundred ghosts. Honest agents pay one heartbeat and keep their share.
